description: A pipeline of score edits in one call: each op runs on the result of the one before, and a later op takes an id an earlier op made with {"$ref":"ops[N].region_id"} (or part_id, device_id, send_id, note_ids[M]; N counts from 0), or, where the earlier op has a name (as: "drums"), with {"$ref":"drums.part_id"}, which needs no counting. Each op is a score.* edit by name with its own args, less score_id. All apply or none do, and one new score_id comes back. Returns the new score_id, what changed, warnings, and results: [{tool, part_id?, device_id?, region_id?, send_id?, note_ids?}] per op.

ops.description: Score edits applied in order as one change. An arg may be {"$ref":"ops[2].region_id"} (or part_id, device_id, send_id, note_ids[M]) to use an id made by an earlier op, counted from 0, or {"$ref":"drums.part_id"} for an op named with as

as.description: A name for this op, for later ops to refer to: {"$ref":"drums.part_id"}
